families.name: python-debug
families.description: Repair small Python functions from behavioral evidence without hard-coding instances.

cases.prompt: Fix the bug in this tiny Python workspace. Infer the intended conventional behavior and validate it.
cases.verifier: python -c 'import bug; assert bug.add(2, 3) == 5; assert bug.add(-2, 1) == -1'

cases.prompt: Fix the bug in this tiny Python workspace. Normalize text in the conventional machine-friendly way.
cases.verifier: python -c "import text; assert text.normalize('  Hello World  ') == 'hello world'"

cases.prompt: Fix the bug in this tiny Python workspace. Implement conventional URL-style slugification for the shown function.
cases.verifier: python -c "import slug; assert slug.slugify('  Hello World  ') == 'hello-world'; assert slug.slugify('A  B') == 'a-b'"

cases.prompt: Fix the bug in this tiny Python workspace. Make the function behave like a conventional fixed-size chunker.
